meaning: Medians of three consecutive windows in one process per scenario/variant; max is worst, counts over33 retain each run. Native submissions, not physical presents. GPU is per-process AGX accumulated milliseconds/window. Profiles excluded.

0.uiReadiness: Provider list, settings, selected-thread target and matching model catalog loaded before warmup
0.inputContinuity: AppKit scrolling keeps 5-second input bridges outside each measured window while controller metadata/process checks run; stderr drains precede both marks

synthetic: Provider events appended with the same SQLite technique as pacing-fixture.ts; no model execution.
One running thread is persisted synthetic state.
PR pages reuse actionFixture({long:true}); no GitHub calls.
Streaming injects production applyEvent deltas in the process, with no live provider.
fixture.png is locally generated by existing gradientPng.
